interpretation: Successful reduced-model repair rerun: all five segmented-electrode unit tests pass and the zero-field/falsification cases execute. Frozen +0.020% width and +0.10% Jpk gates remain unchanged. Several reduced cases pass both gates, but no native M3D-C1 electrode claim is supported. The required energy comparison is not yet trustworthy because segmented_static uses 0.1338245376 reduced energy while the case labelled equivalent_energy_unsegmented uses only 0.0260629982; therefore segmentation benefit is not established. Wrong-polarity and misplaced-layer controls also remain non-discriminating in this reduced closure and are not promoted as evidence.
claim_boundary: Reduced TCT segmented-electrode model only. No claim of native M3D-C1 electrode physics, experimental validation, reactor-scale performance, precursor efficacy, or demonstrated species separation.
